# Copilot instructions - E.D.E.N. Protocol pointer

This repository follows the E.D.E.N. Protocol.
- Read AGENTS.md first; it holds the commands, task lanes, and rules.
- Search .eden/REGISTRY.md before adding helpers or packages.
- Respect the constraints in .eden/ARCHITECTURE.md.
- Before finishing a code change, run `python3 scripts/eden-audit.py --verify`.
